blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Neural implicit representations provide memory-efficient signed distance field (SDF) parameterizations for large-scale LiDAR scenes, but the geometry recovered from sparse and often noisy inputs carries jitter and artifacts. Classical geometric optimization techniques resolve such artifacts with surface energy functionals, whose minimizers correspond to smooth surfaces. Motivated by this principle, we formulate neural LiDAR mapping as the optimization of energy functionals over the parameter space of neural implicit representations. Specifically, we regularize the signed distance field with an energy functional defined on the shape operator of its level set, which represents the curvature of the surface, thus encouraging smoothness along the surface. This adapts classical geometric priors to the scale of million-point LiDAR maps. Experiments on large-scale datasets show reconstructions with improved smoothness at preserved geometric fidelity, and no additional inference-time cost. The code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/nieo}{https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/nieo}
blocks.zh: 神经隐含表示为大型LiDAR场景提供内存高效的签名距离域(SDF)参数化,但从稀疏且经常吵闹的输入中恢复的几何学携带着焦躁和文物. 古典几何优化技术用表面能量功能解决这种文物,其最小化器与平滑的表面相对应. 基于这个原理,我们将神经LiDAR映射作为能量功能在神经隐含表达的参数空间上的优化. 具体地说,我们用其水平集的形状操作器上定义的能量功能来规范已签名的距离场,这代表了表面的曲率,从而鼓励了表面的光滑. 这使得古典几何前缀适应了百万点LiDAR地图的规模. 对大型数据集的实验显示,在保存的几何忠诚度下,重建的光滑度有所提高,没有额外的推论时间成本. 该代码在\href{https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/nieo}{https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/nieo}公开发布.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Constructing accurate geometric representations of large-scale environments is a fundamental task in 3D computer vision. These spatial models serve as the foundation for downstream visual reasoning tasks, simulation frameworks, and autonomous systems [ 3 , 34 , 2 , 33 , 43 ] . To capture these environments, cameras and LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) are the two most common sensors utilized in practice. While cameras capture dense photometric information, LiDAR provides the depth perception essential for spatial modeling and geometric mapping. However, relying directly on raw LiDAR scans presents challenges. Captured point clouds can be noisy and often sparse, particularly in areas with limited sensor coverage. This sparsity makes generating high-fidelity surfaces complex, and the resulting mapped surfaces often exhibit jitter. Ensuring that the reconstructed surface accurately represents the continuous underlying geometry while preserving localized details remains a challenge in large-scale 3D mapping.
blocks.zh: 构建大尺度环境的准确几何表示是3D计算机视觉中的一项根本任务. 这些空间模型是下游视觉推理任务,模拟框架,和自主系统[3,34,2,33,43]的基础. 为了捕捉这些环境,相机和LiDAR(光探测和测距)是实践中最常用的两个传感器. 虽然相机能捕捉密集的测光信息,但LiDAR提供了空间模型和几何绘图所必需的深度感知. 然而,直接依靠原始的LiDAR扫描带来了挑战. 捕捉到的点云可能很吵,而且往往稀少,特别是在传感器覆盖面有限的地区。 这种溅射使得产生高纯度的表面变得复杂,由此产生的映射的表面经常表现出焦躁. 确保重建的地表准确反映连续的基本几何,同时保留局部细节,仍然是大规模三维制图中的一项挑战.

blocks.en: Neural implicit 3D reconstruction frameworks typically map scenes using learnable continuous feature representations [ 61 , 23 ] . When handling large-scale geometry, these frameworks represent the environment using sparse hierarchical spatial features. This serves as a differentiable latent state, using which an implicit neural representation learns a continuous signed distance field (SDF) [ 67 , 50 ] , often using physics-based priors derived from partial differential equations (PDE). Leveraging the connections between the SDF and equations such as Eikonal PDE and the Poisson PDE [ 54 , 67 ] , recent works have regularized neural reconstruction through PDE based objectives. While Eikonal and Poisson constraints provide metric consistency to the learned field, noisy and sparsely sampled LiDAR observations can still introduce spatial jitter in the reconstructed surfaces.
blocks.zh: 神经隐含的3D重建框架一般使用可学习的连续特征表示图景[61,23]. 在处理大规模几何时,这些框架使用稀疏的等级空间特征代表环境. 这是一种不同的潜伏状态,一种隐含的神经表示学学习连续的签名距离场(SDF)[67,50],常使用部分微分方程(PDE)衍生出来的基于物理的前兆. 利用SDF与Eikonal PDE和Poisson PDE等方程式之间的联系[54,67],近期的作品通过基于PDE的目标将神经重建规范化. 虽然Eikonal和Poisson的限制因素为所学领域提供了衡量一致性,但噪音大和采样很少的LiDAR观测仍可能在重建的表面引入空间紧张。

blocks.en: A fundamentally different perspective on surface characterization arises from smoothness priors derived from energy functionals. Neural reconstruction approaches have used Hessians and their energies as penalties [ 66 , 9 ] but often lose geometric detail due to excessive smoothing [ 58 ] . This is addressed by instead imposing constraints on the singular Hessian [ 60 ] or by aligning gradients and the Hessians [ 58 ] . However, these approaches struggle in sparse and large-scale scenes. A key challenge in LiDAR sweeps is that we often have large open regions spanning meters, sampled sparsely and noisily. In these settings, Eikonal constraints can capture larger geometric structures, but noise manifests as surface-level jitter. Meanwhile, classical geometry processing has long leveraged optimization strategies over surface curvature energies defined by shape operators [ 13 , 14 , 20 , 17 , 48 ] , which enable surface smoothing, fairing, bending, and the tuning of surface-level irregularities [ 45 , 35 ] , but their use in large-scale LiDAR mapping remains unexplored.
blocks.zh: 对表面特征的一个根本不同的看法产生于能量功能产生的光滑性前兆。 神经重建方法使用黑森语及其能量作为惩罚[66,9],但往往由于过度平滑而失去几何细节[58]. 为此,对单数黑森[60]施加限制,或调整梯度和黑森[58]。 然而,这些方法在稀少和大规模的场景中挣扎。 在LiDAR扫荡中,一个关键的挑战就是我们经常有大片的空旷地区,它们横跨着几米高,采样稀少,无声无息。 在这些环境中,Eikonal约束可以捕捉更大的几何结构,但噪声表现为表面水平的焦急. 同时,古典几何处理长期利用优化策略来超越由形状操作员定义的表面曲率能量[13,14,20,17,48],这些策略可以使表面平滑,美化,弯曲,调和表面水平的不规则[45,35],但其在大规模LiDAR绘图中的使用仍未被探索.

blocks.en: Our Contribution. Motivated by these classical techniques, in this work, we pose neural LiDAR mapping as a surface energy optimization problem defined over the parameter space of neural representations. We consider the energy functional defined over the shape operator, which measures the surface variations. We find that this energy can characterize the sharp, jitter seen on the reconstructed surface and optimizing over it seeks a minimum energy configuration for reconstruction. By applying this energy as the regularizer for a sparse hierarchical neural implicit representation, we show that the resulting maps exhibit improved geometric fidelity across large-scale datasets. We evaluate our approach on a diverse set of object-, building-, and street-scale scenes using established LiDAR mapping benchmarks, including KITTI [ 19 ] , MaiCity [ 53 ] , and Newer College [ 40 ] . To evaluate reconstruction of more complex surfaces, we additionally construct a synthetic LiDAR benchmark from the Tanks-and-Temples [ 28 ] dataset. We show that our method consistently achieves the highest overall F-scores across these benchmarks, outperforming both LiDAR mapping methods and neural surface reconstruction approaches.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献。 受这些古典技术的驱使,在这部作品中,我们提出神经LiDAR映射是一个表面能量优化问题,定义在神经表达的参数空间上. 我们认为在形状操作员上定义的能量功能可以测量表面的变化。 我们发现,这种能量可以描述重建的表面所看到的尖锐的,焦躁的,并且优化它来寻求重建的最低限度的能量配置. 通过将这种能量用作稀疏层次神经隐含表达的常态,我们显示所产生的地图显示,在大型数据集中,几何忠诚度有所提高。 我们利用既定的LiDAR绘图基准来评价我们对于各种物体、建筑和街道规模的场景,包括KITTI[19]、MaiCity[53]和Newer College[40]。 为了评价更复杂的表面重建,我们还从Tanks-and-Temples[28]数据集构建了合成的LiDAR基准. 我们显示,我们的方法始终达到这些基准中F-分数最高的总体水平,超过了LiDAR绘图方法和神经表面重建方法。

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1 Standard and Neural LiDAR mapping
blocks.zh: 2.1 标准和神经LiDAR绘图

blocks.en: Typical LiDAR mapping approaches relies on a variety of geometric and probabilistic techniques. These involve correspondence point optimization [ 65 , 56 ] , incremental triangulation [ 31 ] , Gaussian Process-based meshing [ 26 , 42 ] , surfel-based meshing [ 7 ] , and coverage maps [ 46 ] . Additionally, volumetric Truncated Signed Distance Function (TSDF) integration frameworks, such as VDBFusion [ 55 ] , provide efficient spatial data structures for merging range sensor data. While effective, these explicit methods often struggle to produce globally smooth manifolds from highly sparse data.
blocks.zh: 典型的LiDAR绘图方法依赖于各种几何和概率技术. 这些问题涉及通信点优化[65,56],增量三角化[31],基于高斯过程的 meshing [26,42],基于表面的 meshing [7],以及覆盖图[46]. 此外,VDBFusion[55]等量子断头功能(TSDF)集成框架为集成范围传感器数据提供了高效的空间数据结构. 这些明确的方法虽然有效,但往往难以从极为稀少的数据中产生全球平滑的多元数据。

blocks.en: To address the limitations of discrete meshing, implicit neural representations have emerged as powerful continuous surrogates for SDF estimation. Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) and Neural LiDAR Fields (NFL) [ 24 ] model scenes through coordinate-based networks [ 4 ] . For memory-efficient large-scale offline mapping, methods such as SHINE [ 67 ] , 3QFP [ 50 ] , PIN-SLAM [ 38 ] , and LONER [ 25 ] introduce sparse, tree-based data structures to accelerate neural implicit reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 为了解决离散的 Meshing 的局限性,隐含的神经表达作为SDF估计的强大连续代位出现. 神经辐射场(NERFs)和神经LiDAR场(NFL)[24] 通过坐标网络的模型场景[. 4] (中文(简体) ). 对于内存高效的大型线下映射,SHINE[67],3QFP[50],PIN-SLAM[38],LONER[25]等方法引入了稀疏,树基的数据结构,以加速神经隐含重建.

blocks.en: 2.2 Physics Based Approaches
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于物理的方法

blocks.en: The emerging physics-based mapping techniques integrate mathematical priors into neural networks to constrain the underlying geometry of the learned manifold. Among these, data-driven approaches [ 22 ] use gradient-based data-dependent kernels within the deep learning framework [ 23 , 62 , 61 ] , while physics-informed approaches embed the governing differential equations like the Eikonal [ 59 , 67 ] or Poisson constraints [ 39 ] as loss functions to guide learning. PUMA [ 54 ] leverages Poisson constraints for LiDAR mapping. Fully data-driven extensions utilize neural operators [ 29 , 5 , 52 ] to implicitly model the underlying PDEs across various graphics tasks [ 1 , 51 , 10 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 新兴的基于物理学的绘图技术将数学前科集成到神经网络中,以限制所学的多面体的基本几何学. 其中,数据驱动方法[22]在深层学习框架内使用基于梯度的数据依赖内核[23,62,61],而物理知情方法嵌入了诸如Eikonal [59,67] 或Poisson 制约等支配性微分方程,作为学习的指导函数. PUMA [54]为LiDAR绘图利用了Poisson的限制. 完全由数据驱动的扩展利用神经运算符[29,5,52],在各种图形任务中隐含地模拟基本的PDE[1,51,10,6].

blocks.en: 2.3 Neural Signed Distance Functions
blocks.zh: 2.3 已签名的神经远程函数

blocks.en: Neural SDFs for surface reconstruction often leverage higher-order gradient terms for improving geometric fidelity. The volumetric Hessian energy, introduced for surface reconstruction by [ 9 ] , is applied to neural fields by RegSDF [ 66 ] , which penalizes the Hessian of the implicit function directly, minimizing the Hessian energy together with a minimal-surface term. [ 58 ] penalizes the product of the Hessian and the local gradient, which vanishes when the gradient is an eigenvector of the Hessian. Neural-Singular-Hessian [ 60 ] minimizes the determinant of the Hessian near the surface. But these approaches can fail in large-scale and highly sparse settings. Other methods include penalizing the divergence of the gradient field [ 8 ] , leveraging periodic activations [ 44 ] , symmetric Chamfer data terms [ 21 ] , perturbed query coordinates [ 32 ] , and neural Galerkin solvers [ 63 ] .
blocks.zh: 用于表面重建的神经SDF常利用更高顺序的梯度术语来提高几何忠诚度. 由[9]引入用于表面重建的体积黑森能量,由RegSDF[66]应用于神经场,直接惩罚暗含功能的黑森人,将黑森能量与最小表面术语一起最小化. [58] 惩罚黑森人的产物和当地梯度,当梯度是黑森人的精度时,梯度就消失了. 神经-静脉-黑森[60] 将海森在表面附近的决定因素最小化. 但是,这些方法在大规模和极为稀少的环境中可能失败。 其他方法包括惩罚梯度字段的差值[8],利用周期激活[44],对称的查姆费尔数据术语[21],扰动的查询坐标[32],神经加勒金解析器[63].

blocks.en: However, it has been shown that directly optimizing Hessian energies can often lead to oversmoothing and eventually mesh degeneracy [ 58 ] . In sparse LiDAR settings, ensuring smooth reconstructions while avoiding mesh degeneracy remains a key challenge. We propose to leverage the shape operators [ 13 , 16 , 30 , 36 , 64 ] , wherein, we define the variational energy over the curvature of the level set. We detail this in Sec. 3 .
blocks.zh: 然而,有证据表明,直接优化黑森能源往往会导致过度流畅,并最终导致网状变质[58]. 在稀少的LiDAR环境中,确保重建顺利进行,同时避免网状退化仍然是一个关键的挑战。 我们提议利用形状操作员[13、16、30、36、64],其中,我们界定了各层的曲率上的变异能量。 我们在3号室详细介绍了这个

blocks.en: We evaluate our approach on standard scene-level LiDAR sweeps. The MaiCity dataset [ 53 ] is a synthetic dataset generated from a 3D CAD model of an urban environment. It contains 100 frames, which were created by simulating LiDAR scans through ray-casting techniques. The Newer College dataset [ 40 ] consists of data captured at New College, Oxford, using a handheld sensor setup, which includes a stereo camera and a 3D LiDAR. This dataset includes 1,500 frames and is accompanied by precise ground truth measurements. Finally, we also benchmark against the KITTI dataset [ 19 ] , a widely used dataset for outdoor odometry tasks. KITTI includes sequences captured with a 64-beam LiDAR sensor, along with camera data, and provides near ground truth estimates for incremental mapping in both urban and rural environments.

blocks.en: Across these datasets, we adopt the hierarchical parameterization strategy established by recent offline implicit models [ 67 , 50 ] . We parameterize the SDF using a differentiable hierarchical octree-based feature grid. Multi-resolution features are stored in hash tables indexed by Morton codes, enabling 𝒪 ⁡ ( 1 ) \mathcal{O}(1) query access without dense memory allocation. For a given 3D point x i x_{i} , the octree features are passed into a shared 2-layer MLP with smooth activations in between the layers. For ground-truth supervision, we compute the ray-aligned signed distance d i d_{i} from the sensor origin to the measured LiDAR point cloud. Following the sampling strategy established in SHINE [ 67 ] , we recognize that precise SDF values far from the surface have very little impact on the final geometry, whereas values close to zero define the surfaces and should exert a higher impact. Thus, the distance is mapped to an occupancy probability l i ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] l_{i}\in[0,1] using a sigmoid function with a truncation hyperparameter σ \sigma , allowing us to densely sample training points within a ± 3 ​ σ \pm 3\sigma band around the surface. blocks.en: To quantitatively assess the fidelity of our neural implicit reconstructions, we leverage the standard reconstruction metrics from the prior works [ 67 ] . Accuracy (Acc.) measures the median distance from the reconstructed surface to the ground-truth point cloud, whereas Completeness (Comp.) quantifies the median distance from the ground-truth points to the reconstructed surface, both evaluated against the surface itself using a bounding volume hierarchy. The Chamfer- L 1 L_{1} (CD- L 1 L_{1} ) distance provides a comprehensive bidirectional nearest-neighbor error. We compute Precision (Acc. Ratio) and Recall (Comp. Ratio) at a per-scene threshold τ \tau to derive the overall F1 score. Following standard evaluation protocols, we employ an error threshold of 10 cm for the MaiCity and KITTI datasets, and 20 cm for the NewerCollege dataset. For KITTI, we utilize an aggregated projection of the point-cloud frames as the ground truth, whereas NewerCollege and MaiCity provide precomputed ground-truth point clouds.

blocks.en: 5.1.1 LiDAR mapping baselines
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 LiDAR绘图基线

blocks.en: We begin by discussing how our proposed approach compares against LiDAR mapping baselines. While baseline architectures approximate a valid SDF, they often lack a governing prior to manage the structural noise inherent in massive, noisy point clouds. As reported in Tab. 1 (where ours refers to energy optimized SHINE framework), our framework improves surface Accuracy and F-scores across all three benchmarks. Compared to the strongest performing baselines, our approach yields accuracy improvements of approximately 11.5% on KITTI (from 7.04 cm to 6.23 cm) and 15.2% on Newer College Dataset (from 6.70 cm to 5.68 cm). When processing millions of LiDAR points, where prior models overfit to sparse regions and produce topological jitter, the energy formulation biases the network toward well-conditioned, smooth SDF. In contrast, we find MaiCity to have more marginal improvements. We observe that this is because the baselines already perform well on this synthetic dataset, where the points are largely well structured. We provide qualitative visual results in Fig. 4 as well as Appendix Fig. 10 . We find that our proposed approach improves over regularizations defined by Poisson forms [ 39 ] , and Dirichlet energy forms [ 49 ] , as shown in Tab. 2 . First, Energy Only optimization performs poorly because it lacks the Eikonal constraint, which enforces the metric structure of the signed distance field and anchors the implicit representation to a valid distance function. Second, the energy operator is sensitive to the high-frequency fluctuations present in the observations, producing gradient magnitudes several orders larger than the primary reconstruction losses. Thus, the energy term must be heavily down-weighted, with the optimum occurring near ( 3 ​ e − 9 3e^{-9} ). In this regime, it operates not as a competing metric constraint, but as a principled geometric inductive bias. It resolves the ill-posedness of sparse point cloud mapping by identifying the geometrically smoothest and most structurally stable manifold from the family of valid distance fields satisfying the Eikonal constraint. Lastly, simpler first-order or Laplacian-based regularizers provide weaker geometric constraints, which is consistent with prior works [ 47 , 48 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们首先讨论了我们提议的方法如何与LiDAR绘图基线相比较。 虽然基线结构大约为有效的SDF,但是在管理大面积的、吵闹的点云所固有的结构噪声之前,往往缺乏治理。 如Tab.1(我们提到优化能源的SHINE框架)所述,我们的框架改进了所有三项基准的表面精确度和F分数。 与最强效基线相比,我们的方法在KITTI(从7.04厘米到6.23厘米)和Newer College Datas集(从6.70厘米到5.68厘米)的精度提高约11.5%。 当处理数百万个LiDAR点,即以前的模型过于适合稀疏的地区,并产生地形焦躁,能量配方将网络偏向条件良好,平滑的SDF. 相比之下,我们发现麦城的改善比较微不足道. 我们观察到,这是因为基准在这个合成数据集上已经运行良好,这些点基本上结构良好。 我们在图4和附录图10中提供了定性的视觉结果。 我们发现,我们所提议的方法比Poisson形式[39]和Drichlet能源形式[49]定义的正规化有所改进,如Tab所示。 2. 首先,能源 只有优化表现不佳,因为它缺乏Eikonal约束,它强制了签名的距离字段的度量结构,并将隐含的表示锁定到有效的距离函数上. 第二,能源运营商对观测中存在的高频波动十分敏感,产生的梯度级比主要重建损失大若干订单. 因此,能源术语必须大量减量,最优的出现时间接近(3e-9 3e-9). 在这一制度中,它不是一种相互竞争的衡量约束,而是一种原则性的几何诱导性偏见。 它通过从符合Eikonal制约的有效距离域的家族中找出最平滑和结构最稳定的多面,解决了稀释点云图的不合理性。 最后,更简单的一阶或Laplacian制成的调节器提供了较弱的几何限制,这与以前的作品[47,48]是一致的.

blocks.en: To analyze our approach more rigorously, we compare our optimization approach with eight baselines - RegSDF [ 66 ] , DiGS [ 8 ] , SIREN [ 44 ] , GradHess [ 58 ] , Singular Hessian [ 60 ] , DiffCD [ 21 ] , Stochastic Preconditioning [ 32 ] and NeuralSSD [ 22 ] . To ensure fairness in comparison, we setup all these approaches over the base SHINE architecture (Denoted by Base). We leverage the Tanks-and-Temples dataset, which provides objects of increasing complexity, ranging from vehicles to building complexes. This enables us to analyze how the approach behaves in objects with complex curved surfaces such as trucks, and on large planar surfaces seen in buildings. Besides F-score, Chamfer distance and normal-augmented F-score from [ 66 ] , we measure the vertex count and, the energy reduction ( Δ ​ E \Delta E ), which is the ratio of curvature energy of the regularization method to the baseline SHINE method. Full definitions are provided in Appendix Sec. E.2 . We present the results in Tab. 3 , with visual results in Fig. 4 , Fig. 3 with additional visuals in the Appendix.

We observe that RegSDF and NeuralSSD generate surfaces which exhibit the highest reduction of energy as well as the lowest vertex count. blocks.en: Limitation: While the energy-based approaches resolve high-frequency structural noise, they inherently create a conservative geometric bias regarding surface completeness. Because the objective explicitly penalizes spatial variations in the normal field, which mathematically correspond to large Hessian magnitudes, the network resists high-curvature topologies. Consequently, baselines can achieve marginally higher absolute completeness on specific datasets (e.g., PIN-SLAM reaching 9.30 cm on NewerCollege compared to our 11.18 cm, or SHINE achieving 3.25 cm on MaiCity vs. our 3.79 cm). Empirically, we observe that this shift toward structurally constrained, noise-reduced mapping directly translates to improved performance and stability in downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 限制: 虽然以能源为基础的方法解决了高频结构噪声,但它们内在地表完整性方面造成了保守的几何偏差。 由于该目标明确惩罚了正常域的空间变异,数学上与大黑森星等相对应,因此网络抵抗高曲率的地形. 因此,在具体数据集上,基线的绝对完整性可以略高(例如,与我们的11.18厘米相比,PIN-SLAM在NewerCollege上达到930厘米,或SHINE在MaiCity对我们的3.79厘米上达到3.25厘米)。 从经验上讲,我们观察到,这种向结构受限制、噪音减少的绘图转变直接意味着下游任务的业绩和稳定性得到改善。

blocks.en: 5.2 Cost-Performance Tradeoff
blocks.zh: 5.2 成本-绩效权衡

blocks.en: Embedding higher-order geometric priors inevitably increases the cost of training , since the curvature energy requires evaluating second-order spatial derivatives through automatic differentiation. Compared to first-order objectives such as the Eikonal loss, this incurs additional memory consumption and computation during optimization. We investigate this overhead in Fig. 5 , which computes the wall-clock time by simulating autograd operations over 40K steps. The second-order formulation requires approximately 45 minutes of training time compared to 25 minutes for a first-order baseline, reflecting the cost of enforcing second-order geometric regularity.
blocks.zh: 嵌入高阶几何前缀不可避免地会增加训练成本,因为曲率能量需要通过自动区分来评价二阶空间衍生物. 与Eikonal损失等一阶目标相比,在优化期间,这会产生额外的内存消耗和计算. 我们在图5中调查这个高架飞行 通过模拟超过40K步的自动分解操作 计算出时数 第二顺序配方需要约45分钟的培训时间,而第一顺序基线则需要25分钟,这反映了执行第二顺序几何规律性的成本.

blocks.en: Importantly, this overhead is incurred only during training . The Hessian energy shapes the parameters of the neural implicit representation, embedding the smoothness prior directly into the learned field. Once optimization is complete, inference consists only of evaluating the neural implicit function itself, requiring no Hessian evaluations, higher-order derivatives, or auxiliary optimization procedures. Consequently, mesh extraction and downstream deployment incur no additional computational overhead beyond that of a conventional neural implicit representation.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,这种管理费用只在培训期间发生。 黑森能量塑造了神经内含的表示的参数,将之前的光滑直接嵌入到学习领域. 一旦优化完成,推论仅包括评价神经内含功能本身,不需要黑森评价,更高阶衍生物,或辅助优化程序. 因此,除常规神经内含的表示外,网状提取和下游部署不会产生额外的计算间接费用。

blocks.en: As an academic point of comparison, one may also consider optimizing the fourth-order biharmonic residual associated with the Euler–Lagrange equation of the surface Hessian energy (also shown in Fig. 5 ). Such a formulation requires nested higher-order automatic differentiation and rapidly becomes computationally prohibitive. Our experiments indicate that a direct fourth-order implementation requires nearly 300 minutes of training, yielding approximately a 6.6 × 6.6\times increase in runtime relative to our Hessian energy formulation.
blocks.zh: 作为比较的学术观点,人们还可能考虑优化表层黑森能量的Euler–Lagrange方程(同样在图5中显示)相关的第四顺序双调残基. 这种配方需要嵌入式更高顺序的自动分化,并迅速在计算上变得令人无法接受。 我们的实验表明,直接执行第四顺序需要近300分钟的培训,与我们的黑森能源配方相比,运行时间大约增加了6.6×6.6倍。

blocks.en: What that additional training time buys is shown in the middle panel of Fig. 5 , which evaluates accuracy at intermediate checkpoints, not only at convergence. The two methods separate within the first few thousand iterations: the energy leads by 0.85 0.85 points at 15 15 k, 0.9 0.9 at 25 25 k, and 1.5 1.5 at 40 40 k. The unregularized baseline peaks near 25 25 k and then drifts back, while the regularized field continues to improve. The prior therefore shapes the optimization trajectory from the outset and does not act as a late correction to an already-converged solution.

blocks.en: 5.3 Downstream Tasks
blocks.zh: 5.3 下游任务

blocks.en: To investigate whether the geometric regularity induced by our energy formulation extends beyond surface reconstruction, we evaluate its impact on Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). In neural implicit SLAM systems, pose estimation is performed by directly registering incoming scans against the learned signed distance field (SDF), with the optimization relying on both the predicted distance values and their spatial gradients. Consequently, the quality of the implicit representation can directly influence downstream localization performance. While the Eikonal objective constrains the magnitude of the SDF gradient, our Hessian energy additionally regularizes its spatial variation, promoting a smoother and more coherent implicit geometry throughout the mapped environment.
blocks.zh: 为了调查我们的能量配制引起的几何规律是否超出表面重建,我们评价其对同时局部化和绘图的影响。 在神经隐含的SLAM系统中,姿势估计是通过直接在已学习到的签名距离域(SDF)上注册进场扫描来完成的,其优化依赖于预测的距离值及其空间梯度. 因此,隐含代表的质量可直接影响下游本地化的表现。 虽然Eikonal目标限制了SDF梯度的大小,但我们的黑森能源进一步规范了空间变异,促进了整个绘图环境中更加平滑和连贯的隐含几何学。

blocks.en: To quantitatively evaluate this effect, we measure the root-mean-square error (RMSE) of the absolute trajectory error (ATE) using Umeyama alignment on the Newer College benchmark. As shown in Tab. 4 , incorporating our energy-optimized implicit representation into the PIN-SLAM mapping backend yields consistent improvements in localization accuracy without modifying the odometry or optimization pipeline. Averaged across all evaluated sequences, our method achieves an ATE RMSE of 0.15 m compared to 0.17 m for the original PIN-SLAM formulation, corresponding to an 11.8% reduction in average trajectory error. Improvements are also observed on several individual sequences, including sequence 01 (0.43 m → \rightarrow 0.39 m, 9.3%), quad e (0.09 m → \rightarrow 0.08 m, 11.1%), and stairs (0.06 m → \rightarrow 0.04 m, 33.3%). Although the proposed energy formulation is designed as a reconstruction prior and not a localization objective, these results indicate that improving the regularity of the learned implicit field can positively influence downstream registration accuracy, highlighting the utility of energy-optimized neural representations for robotics applications, although a detailed analysis of this interaction remains an interesting direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 为了从数量上评价这一效应,我们利用Umeyama校对新学院基准,测量绝对轨迹误差(RMSE)的根-正方位误差(RMSE). 如Tab.4所示,在PIN-SLAM绘图后端中加入我们最优化能量的隐含表示,在不修改Odometry或优化管道的情况下,不断提高本地化精度。 平均在所有评估序列中,我们的方法在最初的PIN-SLAM配方中实现了0.15米的ATE RMSE,相当于平均轨迹误差减少11.8%。 还观察到一些个别序列的改进,包括序号01(0.43米 ~ 右旋0.39米,9.3%)、四(0.09米 ~ 右旋0.08米,11.1%)和楼梯(0.06米 ~ 右旋0.04米,33.3%)。 虽然拟议的能量配制是设计为重建之前的而不是本地化的目标,但这些结果表明,提高所学隐含领域的规律性能够对下游的注册准确性产生积极影响,凸显出最优化的能量神经表达对机器人应用的效用,尽管对这一相互作用的详细分析仍然是未来工作的有趣方向.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced an energy-based framework for neural implicit surface mapping that embeds classical smoothness priors directly into continuous signed distance fields. By treating the neural implicit representation as a parameterization of the minimum-energy configuration of a continuous energy functional, our formulation unifies variational geometry processing with modern neural field representations while remaining computationally practical for large-scale LiDAR mapping. Experiments demonstrate that this energy-driven perspective consistently improves reconstruction fidelity and geometric regularity while generalizing naturally to downstream robotics tasks such as localization and mapping. Broadly, we believe this work establishes energy optimization as a principled foundation for integrating classical geometric priors into neural implicit representations, opening new directions for physically grounded 3D scene understanding.
blocks.zh: 在这个作品中,我们引入了一个基于能量的框架,用于神经内含的表面映射,将古典光滑前缀直接嵌入连续的签名距离场. 通过将神经内含的表示作为连续能量功能最小能构型的参数化,我们的配体将变异几何处理与现代神经场表示统一起来,同时对大规模LiDAR映射仍然在计算上实用. 实验表明,这种由能量驱动的视角不断提高重建的忠诚度和几何规律性,同时自然地概括为下游机器人任务,如本地化和绘图. 广义地说,我们认为,这项工作将能源优化确立为将古典几何前缀融入神经内含表达的原则基础,为实际基于3D的场景理解开辟了新的方向.

finite-difference operators, lumped mass matrices and conic relaxations [ 41 ] . Imposing the prior directly on the continuous signed distance
field evaluates the same quantity through automatic differentiation, so the smoothing
emerges during standard neural optimization without auxiliary variables or specialized
solvers ( Fig. 6 ).

blocks.zh: 附录E 实施和实验细节

blocks.en: To manage memory effectively and ensure scalable optimization, we employ a sliding-window data sampler and a multi-resolution feature octree. The structural parameters of the decoder remain constant across all scenes: a 2-layer MLP with a hidden dimension of 32, querying a feature octree with an 8-dimensional feature vector per node.
blocks.zh: 为了有效管理内存并确保可扩展优化,我们使用滑窗数据取样器和多分辨率特性octree。 解码器的结构参数在所有场景中保持不变:一个2层的MLP,隐藏维度为32,查询一个特征octree,每个节点有一个8维特征矢量.

blocks.en: E.1 Dataset-Specific Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: E.1 数据集特定超参数

blocks.en: To accommodate the varying spatial scale and sensor densities of different environments, specific hyperparameters were tuned per dataset (summarized in Table 8 ). • KITTI (Sequence 00): Due to the massive scale of the outdoor trajectory, we utilized a slightly larger octree leaf voxel size of 0.3 0.3 m. The network was optimized for 40,000 40,000 iterations with an initial learning rate of 0.05 0.05 . • MaiCity & Newer College (NCD): These datasets feature higher local density and tighter structural boundaries. We utilized a finer octree leaf voxel size of 0.2 0.2 m and a reduced learning rate of 0.01 0.01 . Optimization converged effectively at 20,000 20,000 iterations. • Other Scenes: The other settings were all trained for 40,000 40,000 iterations.
